h1: Blue Mountain Beach "My Blue Heaven" 327 Blue Mountain Road
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private pool *Pool can be heated for an additional $45/day during the winter months.*- 300 ft. or 1-minute walk to the Beach- 6-Seater Low-Speed Vehicle- Beach views- 5 adult bikes- Grill- Fireplace- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Discover paradise in the Emerald Coast at My Blue Heaven! This dreamy 6-bedroom, 4-bathroom Blue Mountain Beach home offers a picturesque escape for 14 guests. This laid-back area boasts activities for every type of vacationer—kayak across the rare coastal dune lakes, peruse the local galleries for a unique souvenir, or savor the blissful relaxation of the white sand beaches. No matter the itinerary, guests will love this home’s beautiful outdoor space and amazing location—only 300 feet from beach access!Light-filled and luxurious, the first-level great room warmly welcomes guests to this 2-story home. Step past the sunlit breakfast table for 6 and the long 10-seat dining table into the charming living space. A soaring ceiling and double-height windows create a grand setting, while the fireplace, corner sofa, and 2 plush armchairs provide a cozy spot to curl up and watch TV. High-end appliances and an island that doubles as a breakfast bar for 6 await in the modern kitchen. The adjacent den boasts a couch and TV. Off the kitchen, a screened-in porch with a grill and seating for 6 opens onto a sprawling, fenced-in backyard—the perfect outdoor space for private, leisurely days. Cool off in the groovy kidney pool’s crystalline waters, or kick back with the latest bestseller on the sun loungers, soft patio chairs, or hammock. An umbrella over the 8-person patio table offers shade as guests relax with fresh lemonade. For post-swim convenience, there’s an outdoor shower and a laundry room to refresh towels. When it’s time for bed, find 1 guest bedroom with a king bed, a private bathroom, and outdoor access on this level.The rest of the home’s inviting sleeping accommodations are tucked upstairs, including a gorgeous primary bedroom with king bed and a stunning private bathroom. The 2 guest bedrooms boast a king and a queen bed, respectively, while the bunk room features a full-over-full bed and a twin-over-twin bed. A sleeping nook with a built-in twin-over-twin bunk completes the level.The rest of the home’s inviting sleeping accommodations are tucked upstairs, including a gorgeous primary bedroom with king bed and a stunning private bathroom. The 2 guest bedrooms boast a king and a queen bed, respectively, while the bunk room features a full-over-full bed and a twin-over-twin bed. A sleeping nook with a built-in twin-over-twin bunk completes the level.Experience a divine Blue Mountain Beach retreat at My Blue Heaven. Beach access is a mere stroll across the street and to the right, and guests can easily explore the area with parking for 5 vehicles, 4 complimentary adult bikes, and a low speed vehicle. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 14):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Sleeper SofaSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Full-over-Full and Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed- Additional Sleeping Area: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed*We are happy to welcome up to 2 dogs for an additional non-refundable pet fee of $400, plus tax.
